Renee (CSM): VerdantAI requests a short per-route QPS lift + IP allowlist for a Brazil demo tomorrow 09:00 BRT. They want region pin to sa-east-1 and an autorevoke after 6h. Can eng provision?
Diego (VerdantAI): Hi team, routes: POST /v1/annotate 200->1100 qps, /v1/batch 100->600 qps for 6h. Source CIDRs: 54.94.0.0/22 and 54.94.4.0/22. ASN is 64800. We'll ramp 0->50->100% over 25m. Renewal is next month; prefer no throttles during demo.
Ibrahim (NetEng): We can do per-route overrides and pin routing to sa-east-1. I'll create window verdant-bz-demo-4311 with tags customer-temp,autorevoke. Question: do you need header-based routing?
Diego (VerdantAI): CIDR-based is fine. No header routing. Please set auto-revoke at 15:00 UTC.
Tess (Oncall): I'll add monitoring hooks. Alerts: 5xx > 0.7% for 5m, P95 > 850ms for 5m, token-cost > 20% spike. Rollback policy: immediate rollback if error budget >2% in first 10m. I'll prepare the rollback command.
peering-bot: peering-bot: Peering check started for ASN 64800. Awaiting traceroute sample from customer.
Diego (VerdantAI): Traceroute (trimmed):
traceroute to 34.210.67.89 (34.210.67.89), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.900 ms  0.840 ms  0.810 ms
 2  198.51.100.2  11.234 ms  11.101 ms  11.045 ms
 ...
Ibrahim (NetEng): Staging smoke passed. Staging command used:
redwoodctl rate-window create --name verdant-bz-demo-4311 \
  --cidrs 54.94.0.0/22,54.94.4.0/22 \
  --routes /v1/annotate=1100,/v1/batch=600 \
  --region sa-east-1 --start 2026-04-02T09:00:00-03:00 --end 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z \
  --tags customer-temp,verdantai,autorevoke
Ibrahim (NetEng): Created ticket INF-3829, will push to prod 15m before start for readiness checks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3829
Renee (CSM): Thanks. Action items: Ibrahim -> prod deploy + autorevoke tag, Tess -> monitor + rollback, Diego -> confirm ramp notes post-deploy. Renewal team tagged for follow-up. :rocket:
Diego (VerdantAI): Noted. We may request a diagnostic snapshot ~3h into the window (P95, token-cost delta).
Tess (Oncall): Noted. I'll capture P95/P99, 5xx rate, and token-cost delta and post a short summary after autorevoke.
